title: The Will of Saint Alder's
author: Isandro Dravenmoor
blurb: Juniper Nystrom, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
